title: Nonvanishing of the signed leading coefficient
statement:
Let $T$ be an indeterminate and let
$P(T)=\sum_{r\geq0}c_rT^r\in\mathbf Z[T]$ satisfy $P(0)=1$, that is,
$[T^0]P(T)=1$. Put $b=\deg P$. Then

$$
(-1)^b[T^b]P(T)\in\mathbf Z\setminus\{0\}.
$$

source.place: node def-weil-determinant-constants, order 2866: the assertion $D_i=(-1)^{b_i}[T^{b_i}]P_i(T)\in\mathbf Z\setminus\{0\}$, which the definition of $\Delta\in\mathbf Q^\times$ needs; stated there without proof
